messages.subject: issues with dates on x-axis in R graphics
messages.subject_clean: issues with dates on x-axis in R graphics
messages.body_plain:
I'm studying diachronic change in Old French, specifically change in subject-verb order over the course of about three centuries. I have texts representing 16 different dates, starting in 980 and ending in in 1279. From the structure of my data frame, it's clear that R interprets this as a numeric variable, as intended, but when I plot it (either using plot or barplot), R appears to graph it on the x-axis as a categorical variable, with 16 equally spaced points (although in reality, they are far from equally spaced). I've tried specifying the limits of the x-axis manually, which just piles the points up right next to each other near the beginning of the x-axis. Since 980 is my 0-th date, I've also tried assigning the 16 points in time numbers from 0-299, representing the time period I'm investigating. This also has no effect on the graphing of this variable. I'd appreciate pointers as to how to deal with this. Thanks!

Laurie Zaring

This is hard to answer without seeing, say, the summary of the
(relevant variables of the) data frame. If that variable TIME was
recognized as numeric, R would use an x-axis spacing that should
reflect the numeric distances between the data points (as in, say,
Gries & Hilpert 2010), but again, without seeing a summary, it's hard
to say what happens there. See
<http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/how-to-make-a-great-r-reproducible-example>.

Both R's structure and summary of the data frame appear to indicate that it thinks (correctly) that "Date" is a numeric variable (see attached Structure-Summary V2EMBCLSDATESVVS.txt file; the data frame is the one where I've converted actually dates to integers 0-299 reflecting the original spacing of the dates, but the same thing is true of the data frame in which I used the true dates). The data frame that actually inputs to the plots I'm trying to do, however is a prop.table that has just the percentage of VS order for each date (see attached VS proptable.txt). Here's the code I'm using to get the graphics:

plot(V2DateSinv.prop, type="b")
barplot(V2DateSinv.prop, ylim=c(0.00, 0.20), xlab="Date, all texts", ylab="rate of Germanic inversion with Sn")

I have no better luck when I try to set the xlim argument to 0-299.

Laurie

messages.subject_clean: [StatForLing with R] Re: issues with dates on x-axis in R graphics
messages.body_plain:
What you seem to be wanting to do, I would do like this (reproducible example!):

# generate data
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE)); set.seed(1)
DATE <- rep(seq(1400, 1700, 25), each=15)
ORDER <- sample(letters[1:2], 195, replace=TRUE)

# generate proportion table and plot it
props.of.b <- prop.table(table(DATE, ORDER), 1)[,2]
plot(names(props.of.b), props.of.b, type="b", ylim=c(0, 1),
     xlab="Date, all texts", ylab="rate of Germanic inversion with Sn"); grid()

And that works - why don't you try that?
